result.question: What does the man of God do after speaking?

readings.answer: He went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.
readings.support: So the man of God went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.

assessments.reason: Verse 13:10 says he went another way and did not return by the way he came to Bethel, which is the same as returning by a different way.

result.reason: The passage explicitly says he went another way and did not return the way he came, matching the key’s idea of returning a different way.
